suitableFor: featured-article teasers (large image beside a text column)
single side-by-side image + text feature blocks
editorial highlights with an eyebrow label and CTA
notSuitableFor: grids of multiple repeating items (use cards-teaser)
full-bleed banners with overlaid text (use hero-banner or carousel-hero)

notes: Based on the project's local columns block (no moveInstrumentation dependency). Classes scoped to columns-featured. DA project, so no _columns-featured.json model file.
